# CDMA Workshop

**Platforms:** BREW

<div className="screenshot">

![CDMA Workshop: screenshot 1](./cdma-workshop/img/cdma-workshop.png)

</div>

CDMA Workshop works with CDMA phones through a serial or diagnostic port. The program reads memory and NV parameters,
works with SPC and passwords, and saves backups.
